variants.label: A · 粉白爱心环
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: preview concept for the Android launcher icon of HypnoLoop, a personal anime-inspired fullscreen spiral / expanding heart-ring visual app. Create a single polished square app-icon artwork, frontal orthographic view, full-bleed opaque background. Large centered symbol with balanced negative space, its identifying silhouette contained within the central 68% of the square for adaptive icon masks. Bold clearly readable forms at 48 pixels. No text, no letters, no labels, no phone mockup, no surrounding presentation board, no external cast shadow, no watermark. The icon itself fills the square; do not draw rounded-square borders or cut out transparent corners.
Concept A: clean luminous white background. Three thick vivid hot-magenta (#F400DA) concentric heart contours, evenly spaced, surrounding one crisp white heart in the center. The inner contour unmistakably heart-shaped; the outer contour subtly rounds out while remaining heart-shaped. Flat graphic finish, exceptionally clean smooth curves and precise bilateral symmetry. Modern Japanese anime graphic mood, elegant and playful. Keep the nested heart symbol compact and bold; no tiny extra decorations. This is an entirely new design.
